mutant.expected: Mutant A must drop AC1 to 0 (<1), AC2 to 0 (<3), and AC3 to empty/no-match -- proving none of the three criteria is a tautology that any document would pass. Mutant B must drop AC3's match to empty (rc=1, no output) while leaving AC1/AC2 unaffected -- proving AC3 specifically detects an Axis-1 value narrowing, which is exactly the failure mode the TO names AC3 as the probe for.
mutant.observed: Mutant A: AC1's invocation returned 0 (rc=1); AC2's invocation returned 0 (rc=1); AC3's invocation returned empty (rc=1). All three would FAIL against the truncated document. Mutant B: AC3's invocation returned empty (rc=1, no match for the literal string) -- would FAIL. Both mutants fired exactly as expected; the committed criteria are not satisfiable by an empty, truncated, or silently-narrowed document.
